ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The Turkey file is in the blue drawer. ... The Pakistan file is in the pink drawer. ... The Hungary file is in the white drawer. ... The file on the country whose capital is Budapest is in a drawer of which colour?" -> answer org white; the alt prompt asks about the Pakistan (bridge alt), its 2nd statement. Possible answers after the patch: pink (answer of bridge alt's statement), blue (answer at the same statement slot), brown (the alt prompt's own answer), white (answer org kept).
